description: Sell an item back to its MomoSwap drop's bonding curve for COOK at the current price, minus the trade fee — the drop's guaranteed exit, available while the drop is live (or sold out and not yet graduated). The item goes into the pool's inventory. After graduation use nft_drop_redeem (floor) or list_nft instead. `minCook` refuses a sale below that. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

collection.description: the drop's collection mint (looked up from the item when omitted)

minCook.description: refuse unless the sale pays at least this much COOK

name: nft_drop_sell
title: Sell an NFT back to its drop
